name: nf-cgt
description: Establish selected Norfolk Island capital gains and losses for 2026-27. Use for asset disposals, contract dates, the Norfolk pre-reform transition, capital proceeds, cost base, loss ordering, discount eligibility, homes, collectables and foreign-resident property. Covers the October 2026 property and ownership-interest amendments and conditional renewable-energy concession. Includes primary legislation, fictional calculations and source-period checks. Distinguishes current-year rules from enacted 2027 changes, capital losses from deductions, and transfer fees from CGT. Preserves residence, valuation, treaty, withholding, specialised-event and actual-return gates, applicable workflow outputs and professional review. This reference does not complete the country pack.
